title: Anti-sting concoction
content:
# Anti-sting concoction

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadBugRepellent | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Anti-sting x1 | Duration: 10m | Cooldown: 0s | Other Effect(s): Prevent Deathsquito attacks

# Introduction

Anti-sting concoction is a Plains-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Anti-sting.

## Recipe

Mead base: Anti-sting is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Cloudberries
• 3 Grouper
• 1 Fragrant bundle
Six Anti-sting concoctions are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Consuming it grants protection against Deathsquitoes. They will still approach the player, but will flee three to eight meters away instead of attacking.

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
